text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Daily Times Newspapers recovers property sold off by the recently dismissed mangement of the company.

- Nigerian Deposit Insurance Corporation pays 267.66 million naira to depositors in four liquidated banks; Financial Merchant Bank, Kapital Merchant Bank, Alpha Merchant Bank and United Commercial Bank.

- Politicians in groups which failed electoral commission conditions for registration are trying to take over the five succesful parties, to ensure a role for themselves in the plan to restore democracy by October 1998.
